verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes several excerpts from the public GitHub repository github.com/wandb/weave, which suggests the source is publicly readable. However, no item states the license or confirms it is open source, so the 'open license' part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any documented license (e.g. Apache/MIT) for the repository, explicit confirmation that the full product source (SDK and server/UI) is published, and independent corroboration.
